Yes — Version A is what I want. Keeping "Recipes I want to try" and my own description while the site name and picture update to the new page is exactly the balance I was hoping for. My own words staying mine is the important part, and it does that without making me stop and confirm every time.

I don't think I need the "ask first" version — having to review and approve every address fix would slow me down, and the whole point of this app is less fuss. So let's go with Version A: refresh the site, picture, and the auto-collected bits from the new page, but never throw away a title or description I wrote myself. That's the behavior I'd like.
